name: שׁוּעָל
summary: Shual is a son of Zophah in the genealogy of Asher. His name has the same form as the animal name used of the fox in Nehemiah.

evidence.note: Shual is named among Zophah’s sons, between Harnepher and Beri.
The same singular form names the animal in Tobiah’s taunt about the wall.
